# Kairo

> Kairo is a batteries-included TypeScript backend framework with built-in AI model support (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama and OpenAI-compatible providers with fallback, structured output, streaming, embeddings and usage tracking), plus routes, schemas, database (PostgreSQL and in-memory), auth, an MCP server and OpenAPI, with zero runtime dependencies. Runs on Node.js 22.18+, Bun, Deno and edge runtimes. Package: @browserlessapi/kairo.

Key rules: routes are private unless `auth: "public"`; validate input with `t.*` schemas; use `db.<table>` methods (never string-built SQL); every model has id, createdAt, updatedAt automatically; relative imports end in `.ts`; run `kairo describe --json` to see an app and `kairo check --json` after changes.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/kairo/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): install, project layout, minimal app
- [Schemas](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/kairo/blob/main/docs/schema.md): t.* types, modifiers, validation, JSON Schema
- [Models and database](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/kairo/blob/main/docs/database.md): model(), queries, adapters, db push, transactions
- [Routes](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/kairo/blob/main/docs/routes.md): options, handler context, return values, errors, middleware
- [Auth](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/kairo/blob/main/docs/auth.md): auth.resolve, roles, bearer API keys, passwords
- [AI](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/kairo/blob/main/docs/ai.md): providers, aliases and fallback, structured output, streaming, embeddings, usage and budgets
- [MCP, OpenAPI and describe](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/kairo/blob/main/docs/mcp.md)
- [CLI](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/kairo/blob/main/docs/cli.md)
- [Testing](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/kairo/blob/main/docs/testing.md)
- [Deployment](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/kairo/blob/main/docs/deploy.md)
- [Error codes](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/kairo/blob/main/docs/errors.md): every KRxxxx code with its fix
